speedspelling.title: Speed Spelling
speedspelling.objective: Tap the floating letters to spell the target word correctly. Mastering this skill ensures your written communication is clear, professional, and effective.
speedspelling.tip: PRO TIP: Sound the word out slowly in your head before tapping the letters.

idiommatch.title: Idiom Master
idiommatch.objective: Match the idiom to its real meaning. Expanding your vocabulary is the ultimate secret to sounding like a true native speaker.
idiommatch.tip: PRO TIP: Idioms rarely mean what the individual words mean literally. Think about the feeling or situation they describe!

speaking.title: Voice Mastery
speaking.objective: Tap mic and repeat the phrase clearly at a natural pace. Mastering this skill ensures your spoken English sounds clear and natural in real-world conversations.
speaking.tip: PRO TIP: Record yourself! Comparing your pitch to the model helps master the natural rhythm.

listening.title: Audio Analysis
listening.objective: Listen carefully and choose the correct answer option. Mastering audio analysis helps you accurately understand native speakers in real-world conversations.
listening.tip: PRO TIP: Close your eyes! Focusing on pure sound helps catch subtle phoneme changes.

reading.title: Text Comprehension
reading.objective: Read the passage carefully and answer the comprehension questions. Mastering reading comprehension allows you to quickly extract key information in the real world.
reading.tip: PRO TIP: Scan for keywords first! Don't get stuck on one word; focus on the overall message.

writing.title: Sentence Construction
writing.objective: Arrange the words in the correct order to build a complete sentence. Mastering this skill ensures your written communication is clear, professional, and effective.
writing.tip: PRO TIP: Start with the verb! Finding the action helps the rest of the sentence fall into place.

grammar.title: Structural Logic
grammar.objective: Fix the underlying structural errors to complete the sentence. Mastering structural rules ensures your English is accurate and easily understood.
grammar.tip: PRO TIP: Read the sentence out loud in your head! Often, you can 'hear' if a rule is being broken.

vocabulary.title: Word Power
vocabulary.objective: Match words to their correct definitions to expand your vocabulary. Expanding your vocabulary is the ultimate secret to sounding like a true native speaker.
vocabulary.tip: PRO TIP: Visual associations help! Try to link the word to a picture in your mind.

accent.title: Phonetic Drill
accent.objective: Focus on rhythm and pitch. Sound exactly like a native speaker. Mastering pronunciation ensures your spoken English sounds clear and natural.

findWordMeaning.title: Word Detective
findWordMeaning.objective: Read the passage and deduce the meaning of the highlighted word from its context. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.
findWordMeaning.tip: PRO TIP: Look at the sentence right before and right after the word—they usually hold the biggest clues!

guessTitle.title: Title Generator
guessTitle.objective: Read the short story and determine the most appropriate title for it. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.

paragraphSummary.title: Summary Synthesis
paragraphSummary.objective: Read the paragraph and select the sentence that best summarizes its main point. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.

readAndAnswer.title: Fact Finder
readAndAnswer.objective: Read the text carefully and answer the specific comprehension questions. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.

readAndMatch.title: Connection Maker
readAndMatch.objective: Read the descriptions and match the related concepts together. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.
readAndMatch.tip: PRO TIP: Look for synonyms! The answer rarely uses the exact same vocabulary as the text.

readingConclusion.title: Logical Leap
readingConclusion.objective: Read the evidence presented in the text and draw the correct logical conclusion. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.
readingConclusion.tip: PRO TIP: Don't guess based on your own knowledge—only use the facts provided in the text.

readingInference.title: Hidden Truth
readingInference.objective: Read between the lines to discover what the author implies but does not explicitly state. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.

readingSpeedCheck.objective: Read the passage as fast as you can while maintaining full comprehension. Mastering reading comprehension accelerates your overall English fluency.

trueFalseReading.title: Fact Checker

school.title: School Days
school.objective: Ring ring, time for class! Check the teacher's notepad, and pack the correct school supply onto your desk.
school.tip: PRO TIP: Think about what you carry in your backpack! 🎒

home.title: My Sweet Home
home.objective: Let's decorate our dream house! Read the architect's blueprint, and move the correct piece of furniture into the home.
home.tip: PRO TIP: Think about which room you would find this item in! 🏠

opposites.title: Big and Small
opposites.objective: Let's find the perfect balance! Read the clue on the golden scale, and drop the exact opposite word to level it out.
opposites.tip: PRO TIP: Opposites are totally different, like Hot and Cold! 🧊

verbs.title: Action Time!
verbs.objective: Get ready for the big game! Look at the jumbotron scoreboard, and throw the correct action-word sports ball into the stadium.
verbs.tip: PRO TIP: A verb is something you can DO, like jump or run! 🏃

prepositions.title: Where is it?
prepositions.objective: Let's go on a treasure hunt! Read the directional banner, and drop the correct arrow block onto the treasure map.
prepositions.tip: PRO TIP: Think about where things are placed, like IN a box or ON a table! 📦

routine.title: My Daily Day
routine.objective: Let's plan a healthy day! Check the alarm clock to see what time it is, and stick the right daily habit on your calendar.
routine.tip: PRO TIP: Think about what you do when you wake up or go to bed! 🪥

phonics.title: Sound Master
phonics.objective: Turn up the volume! Read the phonetic clue on the speaker, and plug the matching sound wave into the amplifier.
phonics.tip: PRO TIP: Say the sound out loud to help you find the right match! 🗣️

time.title: Tick Tock!
time.objective: Tick tock! Look at the time on the chalkboard, and strap the matching digital clock onto the smartwatch.
time.tip: PRO TIP: Remember, 12:00 can be noon or midnight! ⏰

day_night.title: Sun and Moon
day_night.objective: Look up at the sky! Peer through the telescope to read the clue, and switch the window to show the correct time of day.
day_night.rule_1: Decide if it's day or night
day_night.tip: PRO TIP: Does this happen when it's sunny or dark outside? 🌙

weather.title: Sky Explorer
weather.objective: Let's become a meteorologist! Read the weather report on the billboard, and float the correct cloud into the sky.
weather.tip: PRO TIP: Think about what you wear when it rains or snows! ☁️

professions.title: Community Helpers
professions.objective: Meet our community heroes! Read the job description on the building, and pin the correct worker badge to the town board.
professions.tip: PRO TIP: Think about what this person does to help the town! 👩‍🚒
